name: MAGNESIUM SULPHURICUM
key_symptoms: Frequent eructations, tasting like bad eggs. Rising of water in mouth.
Apprehensive; vertigo; head heavy during menses. Eyes burn, noises in ears.
The left arm and foot fall asleep in bed, in the morning after waking.
guiding_symptoms: Frequent eructations, tasting like bad eggs. Rising of water in mouth.
Apprehensive; vertigo; head heavy during menses. Eyes burn, noises in ears.
The left arm and foot fall asleep in bed, in the morning after waking.
head_symptoms: Apprehensive; vertigo; head heavy during menses. Eyes burn, noises in ears.
gi_symptoms: Frequent eructations, tasting like bad eggs. Rising of water in mouth.
urinary_symptoms: Stitches and burning in the orifice of the urethra after urinating. Stream intermits and dribbles. The urine passed in the morning copious, bright yellow, soon becomes turbid, and deposits a copious red sediment. The urine is greenish as passed; is of a clear color, and in a large quantity. Diabetes (Phos ac; Lact ac; Ars brom).
musculoskeletal_symptoms: The left arm and foot fall asleep in bed, in the morning after waking.
skin_symptoms: Small pimples over the whole body, that itch violently. Suppressed itch (Sulph). Crawling in the tips of the fingers of the left hand; better on rubbing. Warts. Erysipelas (applied locally as a saturated solution). Dropsy (physiological doses).
fever_symptoms: Chill from 9 to 10 am. Shuddering in back; heat in one part and chill in another.

source.title: MAGNESIUM SULPHURICUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
